name: Pasquale Tridico - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section VIII – European Ombudsman
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Ombudsman spent its 2024 budget. The Ombudsman is the official who handles citizens' complaints about how European Union bodies treat them. Parliament notes the office stayed within its budget and paid bills on time. It also raises concerns: a top post sat empty for over two years, the new senior hire previously worked for the Ombudsman, and some document-access cases took much longer. Parliament asks for better planning, fairer hiring, and faster handling of access requests.

- Parliament formally approves the Ombudsman's 2024 spending; no law changes.
- The Ombudsman must answer Parliament's concerns on hiring and delays.
- The Ombudsman should send Parliament documents from the senior hiring process.
